name: Property Meld
positioning: Residential maintenance coordination as its own discipline — because it is where property managers lose their margin and their reputation.
description: Property Meld handles the maintenance workflow for residential property management: tenant request intake with triage, vendor scheduling and coordination, communication across all parties, and analytics on speed and cost per repair.
real_estate_use: In residential management, maintenance is the largest source of complaints and the biggest drain on staff time — mostly spent as phone tag between a tenant, a vendor and an owner trying to agree a time. Property Meld automates the scheduling coordination, and its metrics — median speed to resolution, cost per unit — are the ones managers now report to owners.
features: Tenant maintenance request intake with guided triage
Automated vendor and tenant scheduling coordination
Owner approval workflows for repairs above a threshold
Communication log across tenant, vendor and owner

use_cases.job: Eliminate phone tag between tenant, vendor and owner on every repair
Approve repairs above a threshold with the evidence in front of you
